lead.headline: COP31 DEAL LANDS AT DAWN — WITH NO MENTION OF FOSSIL FUELS
lead.summary: The final text of the Antalya climate talks lands at dawn, keeping a 35% clean-electricity goal for 2035 and dropping the $120bn adaptation target. It is the first COP text to admit the world will overshoot 1.5°C. Objections close 03:00 GMT; approval due 06:00.
